requirements.text: No-data / location-not-found shows its own distinct message with retry option (AC-1).
test_refs: weatherClient.test.ts::throws NoDataError when the response is OK but has no current conditions (AC-1)
failureMessages.test.ts::gives a distinct message for no-data (AC-1)
CurrentConditionsCard.test.tsx::shows a distinct no-data message with retry available (AC-1)

requirements.text: Weather Provider unreachable shows a distinct "provider unreachable" message with retry option (AC-2).
test_refs: weatherClient.test.ts::throws ProviderUnreachableError on a non-OK response with no explicit error body (AC-2)
failureMessages.test.ts::gives a distinct message for provider-unreachable (AC-2)
CurrentConditionsCard.test.tsx::wires the manual refresh control through to onRefresh (AC-2)

requirements.text: Weather Provider explicit error response shows a distinct "provider error" message with retry option (AC-3).
test_refs: weatherClient.test.ts::throws ProviderError on a non-OK response carrying an explicit provider error (AC-3)
failureMessages.test.ts::gives a distinct message for provider-error (AC-3)

requirements.text: Device network connectivity failure shows a distinct "network error" message with retry option (AC-4).
test_refs: weatherClient.test.ts::throws NetworkError when the device can't reach the network at all (AC-4)
failureMessages.test.ts::gives a distinct message for network-error (AC-4)
CurrentConditionsContainer.test.tsx::shows a distinct failure message when the fetch fails (AC-1..4)

requirements.text: Successful manual retry replaces the failure message with live Current Conditions (AC-5).
test_refs: useCurrentConditions.test.ts::clears the failure on a successful manual retry (AC-5)

requirements.text: Failed manual retry shows the (possibly different) failure-type message, retry still available (AC-6).
test_refs: useCurrentConditions.test.ts::shows the new failure type when a manual retry fails differently (AC-6)

requirements.text: The staleness indicator and a failure message are never shown at the same time — mutually exclusive states (AC-7).
test_refs: useCurrentConditions.test.ts::never sets a failureType when a refresh fails but prior good data exists (AC-7 mutual exclusivity)
CurrentConditionsCard.test.tsx::never shows a stale badge or live dot alongside a failure message (AC-7 mutual exclusivity)
CurrentConditionsCard.test.tsx::shows a stale stamp badge alongside the original timestamp when data is stale, never a failure message (AC-6, AC-7)
requirements.notes: Confirmed both structurally (hook) and via UI rendering tests.
